        N = table.freeze({region = W.region, a = x, b = i, c = f, thickness = W.thickness, solid = W.solid, minX = math.min(x.X, i.X, f.X), maxX = math.max(x.X, i.X, f.X), minZ = math.min(x.Z, i.Z, f.Z), maxZ = math.max(x.Z, i.Z, f.Z)})
        table.insert(s, N)

          if not (V[N.region]) then

          end
        end
      end
    end
    table.freeze(s)
    P = 0
    for N in o, nil, nil do
      P += 1
    end
    local N = {}
    for W, W in ipairs(j.rectFloors) do
      if l[W.id] ~= true then
        table.insert(N, W)
      end
    end

    for n, p in ipairs(j.walls) do

        G.exactLength, G.flat, G.right = p.exactLength == true, o, M
        T(i, G)
      end
    end
    for l, l in ipairs(D) do

    end

      end

    local function W(x, m, n, p)

    local function m(n, p, v, M, T, G)
      W(n, p, v, G)

      elseif M == "border" then

    local function b(d, Q, n)
      local p = Q[n]

        return p

    local function d(Q, n)
      local p, v, M = Q.a, Q.b, Q.c
      local T, G, w = v - p, M - p, M - v
      if T:Cross(G).Magnitude < 0.0001 then
        return {}
      end
      if (T:Dot(T) > G:Dot(G)) and (T:Dot(T) > w:Dot(w)) then
        p, M = M, p
      else
        if G:Dot(G) > w:Dot(w) then
          p, v = v, p
        else
        end
      end
      T, G, w = v - p, M - p, M - v
      local k = G:Cross(T).Unit
      local S, J0 = w:Cross(k).Unit, w.Unit
      local w, E0, e0, t0, F0 = math.abs(T:Dot(S)), ((if k.Y >= 0 then k else -k) * Q.thickness) * 0.5, {}, ipairs, {{(p + v) * 0.5, k, J0, math.abs(T:Dot(J0))}, {(p + M) * 0.5, -k, -J0, math.abs(G:Dot(J0))}}
      for p, v in t0(F0) do
        if v[4] >= 0.001 then
          J0 = Instance.new("WedgePart")
          J0.Size = Vector3.new(Q.thickness, w, v[4] + 0.015)
          J0.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(v[1] - E0, v[2], S, v[3])
          W(J0, "Temporary_" .. (tostring(Q.solid) .. ("_" .. p)), n, r)
          table.insert(e0, J0)
        end
      end
      return e0
    end
    local function Q(W, n)
      local p, v = {}, {}
      for M, T in ipairs(s) do
        if not (V[T.region]) then
          M = b(W, n, T.region)
          p[T.solid] = p[T.solid] or {}
          v[T.solid] = T.region
          for V, V in ipairs(d(T, M)) do
            table.insert(p[T.solid], V)
          end
        end
      end
      local d = {}
      for V, M in p, nil, nil do
        assert(#M >= 2, "Northern Lands floor solid has insufficient geometry: " .. tostring(V))
        local p = table.remove(M, 1)
        local T = t:UnionAsync(p, M, H)
        if #T ~= 1 then
          for G, G in ipairs(T) do
            G:Destroy()
          end
          error("Northern Lands floor union did not produce one solid: " .. tostring(V))
        end
        local G, w = b(W, n, v[V]), T[1]
        m(w, "FloorSolid_" .. V, G, "floor", "floor-" .. V, r)
        d[V] = w
        p:Destroy()
        for V, V in ipairs(M) do
          V:Destroy()
        end
      end
      return d
    end
    local function d(V, W)

    local function V(N, W)
      local n = {}
      for p, v in ipairs(U) do
        local M, T = q(v.cframe), {}
        for G, w in ipairs(v.rectangles) do
          p = Instance.new("Part")
          p.Name = "TemporaryRaster_" .. tostring(G)
          p.Size = Vector3.new(v.thickness, w.sizeY, w.sizeZ)
          p.CFrame = M * CFrame.new(0, w.localY + (w.sizeY * 0.5), w.localZ + (w.sizeZ * 0.5))
          table.insert(T, p)
        end
        assert(#T >= 1, "Northern Lands raster floor union has no rectangles")
        M = table.remove(T, 1)
        local p = t:UnionAsync(M, T, H)
        if #p ~= 1 then
          for t, t in ipairs(p) do
            t:Destroy()
          end
          M:Destroy()
          for t, t in ipairs(T) do
            t:Destroy()
          end
          error("Northern Lands raster floor union did not produce one solid: " .. tostring(v.id))
        end
        local t, H = b(N, W, v.region), p[1]
        m(H, v.name, t, "floor", v.id, r)
        n[v.id] = H
        M:Destroy()
        for t, t in ipairs(T) do
          t:Destroy()
        end
      end
      return n
    end
    local function t(H, N)
      local W = {}
      for n, n in ipairs(Y) do

        p.TextureID = ""

    local function e(H, Y)
      for N, W in ipairs(Z) do
        N = b(H, Y, W.region)
        for H = 1, #W.stations - 1, 1 do
          local Y, Z, n, p = W.stations[H][1], W.stations[H][2], W.stations[H + 1][1], W.stations[H + 1][2]
          local v, M, T, G, w = (Y + Z) * 0.5, (n + p) * 0.5, (Z - Y).Magnitude, (p - n).Magnitude, ((Z - Y) + (p - n)).Unit
          Z = M - v
          p = w:Cross((Z - (w * Z:Dot(w))).Unit).Unit
          if p.Y < 0 then
            w, p = -w, -p
          else
          end
          n, Y = w:Cross(p).Unit, Instance.new("Part")
          Y.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(T, G) + (W.widthPadding or 0.4), W.thickness, Z.Magnitude + (W.lengthPadding or 0.6))
          Y.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(((v + M) * 0.5) - ((p * W.thickness) * 0.5), w, p, n)
          m(Y, "RampSection_" .. H, N, "floor", W.region .. (":ramp-" .. H), r)
        end
      end
    end
    local function r(H, Y)
      for Z, N in ipairs(i) do
        Z = b(H, Y, "08_Borders_" .. N.region)
        local H
        if N.cframe then
          H = Instance.new("Part")
          H.Size = N.size
          H.CFrame = N.cframe
        else
          if math.abs(N.a.Y - N.b.Y) < 0.05 then
            H = Instance.new("Part")
            H.Size = Vector3.new(N.width, N.height, N.flat.Magnitude + ((N.exactLength and 0) or 0.35))
            H.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(((N.a + N.b) * 0.5) + ((Vector3.yAxis * N.height) * 0.5), N.right, Vector3.yAxis, N.right:Cross(Vector3.yAxis))
          else
            local Y = N.b - N.a
            local W = Y.Unit
            local n = Vector3.new(W.X, 0, W.Z)
            local p = if n.Magnitude > _ then Vector3.new(-n.Z, 0, n.X).Unit else Vector3.xAxis
            local v, M = p:Cross(W).Unit
            if v.Y < 0 then
              M, v = -p, -v
            else
              M = p
            end
            n = M:Cross(v).Unit
            H = Instance.new("Part")
            H.Size = Vector3.new(N.width, N.height, Y.Magnitude + 0.5)
            H.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(((N.a + N.b) * 0.5) + ((v * N.height) * 0.5), M, v, n)
          end
        end
        m(H, N.name, Z, "border", N.id, L)
        if N.transparency ~= nil then
          H.Transparency = N.transparency
        end
      end
    end
    local function L(H, Y)

    local function b(H, Y, Z)

    local function j(H)

      for Z, Z in ipairs(H:GetDescendants()) do
        Y = if Z:IsA("BasePart") then if Z.CanCollide then Y + 1 else Y else Y
      end

    local function H(Y)
      local Z = {}
      local N = Q(Y, Z)
      d(Y, Z)
      V(Y, Z)

      e(Y, Z)
      r(Y, Z)
      L(Y, Z)

    local function e()
      if x then
        local t = x
        return t
      end
      local t = Instance.new("Model")
      t.Name = B
      local R, r = xpcall(function()
        H(t)
        return t
      end, debug.traceback)
      if not (R) then
        t:Destroy()
        return nil, tostring(r)
      end
      x = r
      R = x
      return R
    end
    local function t(R)
      for r, r in ipairs(R:GetDescendants()) do
        if r:IsA("BasePart") then
          if r.CanCollide then
            if r:GetAttribute("EthosTraversalKind") ~= nil then
              J:AddTag(r, c)
            else
              J:RemoveTag(r, c)
            end
          else
            J:RemoveTag(r, c)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    local function R(r)
      return ((((((r ~= nil) and r:IsA("Model")) and (r:GetAttribute(z) == true)) and (r:GetAttribute("Revision") == E)) and (r:GetAttribute("PhysicalPartCount") == P)) and (j(r) == P)) and (r:FindFirstChild("RoomFive_OneWayDrop") ~= nil)
    end
    local function j(r)
      local L = r:FindFirstChild(B)
      if R(L) then
        t(L)
        return L
      end
      local R, b = e()
      if not (R) then
        return nil, "failed to build Northern Lands synthetic geometry: " .. tostring(b)
      end
      b = R:Clone()
      b.Name = B .. "_Building"
      b.Parent = r
      if L then
        L:Destroy()
      end
      b.Name = B
      t(b)
      return b
    end
    local function e(t, R)
      local r = t
      while r and (r ~= R) do
        if r:GetAttribute(z) == true then
          return true
        end
        r = r.Parent
      end
      return false
    end
    local function t(R, r)
      if e(R, r) then
        return 0
      end
      if R:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not (R.CanCollide) then
          if R.Transparency >= 1 then
            J:RemoveTag(R, c)
            return 0
          end
        end
        R:Destroy()
        return 1
      end
      local J = 0
      for c, c in ipairs(R:GetChildren()) do
        J += t(c, r)
      end
      return J
    end
    local function J(R, c)
      local r = 0
      for L, L in ipairs(R:GetChildren()) do
        r = if L ~= c then r + t(L, R) else r
      end
      return r
    end
    local function R(c)
      local r = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
      if not (r) then
        return false
      end
      r:FillBlock(a, g, Enum.Material.Air)
      return true
    end
    local function c(r)
      if r ~= workspace then
        return true
      elseif not (workspace.StreamingEnabled) then
        return true
      end
      r = F.LocalPlayer
      if not r then
        return false, "local player is unavailable for map streaming"
      end
      for F, F in ipairs(A) do
        local L, b = pcall(r.RequestStreamAroundAsync, r, F, 3)
        if not (L) then
          return false, "failed to stream Northern Lands route: " .. tostring(b)
        end
      end
      return true
    end
    local function F(r, L)
      local b = L
      while b and (b.Parent ~= r) do
        b = b.Parent
      end
      return if b then if b.Parent == r then b else nil else nil
    end
    local function r(L)
      if type(L) ~= "string" then
        return false
      end
      local b = tonumber(string.match(L, "^room(%d+)$"))
      return ((b ~= nil) and (b >= 1)) and (b <= 6)
    end
    local function L(b)
      local d = b:FindFirstChild("dungeon")
      if not (d) then
        return 0
      end
      b = 0
      for Q, H in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
        Q = H:FindFirstChild("barrier")
        if Q then
          if r(H.Name) then
            local d = b
            for H, H in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants()) do
              if H:IsA("BasePart") then
                if H.Name == "physicalBarrier" then
                  y.Preserve(Q, H)
                  H:Destroy()
                  d += 1
                else
                end
              else
              end
            end
            b = d
          else
          end
        else
        end
      end
      return b
    end
    local function b(d, Q, H)
      if Q < (d.minX - _) then
        return nil
      elseif Q > (d.maxX + _) then
        return nil
      elseif H < (d.minZ - _) then
        return nil
      elseif H > (d.maxZ + _) then
        return nil
      end
      local a, g, A = d.a, d.b, d.c
      d = ((g.Z - A.Z) * (a.X - A.X)) + ((A.X - g.X) * (a.Z - A.Z))
      if math.abs(d) < 1e-08 then
        return nil
      end
      local Y, V = (((g.Z - A.Z) * (Q - A.X)) + ((A.X - g.X) * (H - A.Z))) / d, (((A.Z - a.Z) * (Q - A.X)) + ((a.X - A.X) * (H - A.Z))) / d
      Q = (1 - Y) - V
      if Y < -_ then
        return nil
      elseif V < -_ then
        return nil
      elseif Q < -_ then
        return nil
      end
      return ((Y * a.Y) + (V * g.Y)) + (Q * A.Y)
    end
    local d = {}
    for Q, Q in ipairs(h) do
      table.insert(d, table.freeze({cframe = q(Q.cframe), size = X(Q.size), surfaceY = Q.surfaceY}))
    end
    table.freeze(d)
    local Q = {}
    for H, H in ipairs(U) do
      table.insert(Q, table.freeze({cframe = q(H.cframe), surfaceY = H.surfaceY, rectangles = H.rectangles}))
    end
    table.freeze(Q)
    local function H(a, g, A)
      local h = a.cframe:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(g, a.surfaceY, A))
      if math.abs(h.X) > ((a.size.X * 0.5) + _) then
        return nil
      elseif math.abs(h.Z) > ((a.size.Z * 0.5) + _) then
        return nil
      end
      return a.surfaceY
    end
    local function a(g, A, h)
      local U = g.cframe:PointToObjectSpace(Vector3.new(A, g.surfaceY, h))
      for A, A in ipairs(g.rectangles) do
        if U.Y >= (A.localY - _) then
          if U.Y <= ((A.localY + A.sizeY) + _) then
            if U.Z >= (A.localZ - _) then
              if U.Z <= ((A.localZ + A.sizeZ) + _) then
                return g.surfaceY
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function _(g, A)
      local h
      for U, Y in ipairs(s) do
        U = b(Y, g, A)
        h = if U ~= nil then if h == nil then U else math.max(h, U) else h
      end
      for b, U in ipairs(d) do
        b = H(U, g, A)
        h = if b ~= nil then if h == nil then b else math.max(h, b) else h
      end
      for b, d in ipairs(Q) do
        b = a(d, g, A)
        h = if b ~= nil then if h == nil then b else math.max(h, b) else h
      end
      return h
    end
    O.Apply = function(b)
      local d = D(b)
      if not (d) then
        return nil, "workspaceRoot is required"
      end
      if I(d, b) ~= u then
        return nil, "current dungeon does not use the Northern Lands synthetic map"
      end
      b = o(d)
      if not b then
        return nil, "map is not ready"
      end
      local Q, H = c(d)
      if not (Q) then
        return nil, H
      end
      Q, H = j(b)
      if not Q then
        return nil, H
      end
      local j, c, H = J(b, Q), R(d), L(d)
      b:SetAttribute(z, true)
      return table.freeze({dungeonName = u, mode = "synthetic-smooth-map", revision = E, supportParts = K, borderParts = #i, geometryParts = P, markerParts = #l, destroyedMapChildren = j, destroyedRoomBarriers = H, terrainCleared = c}), b
    end
    O.Watch = function(J, j)
      if typeof(J) ~= "Instance" then
        return nil
      end
      local R, u = j or workspace, true
      local c = J.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(b)
        task.defer(function()
          if u then
            if b.Parent then
              if b:IsDescendantOf(J) then
                if not (e(b, J)) then
                  t(b, J)
                end
              end

        end
      else
        return nil
      end
    else
      return nil
    end
    local J, F, y = math.abs(e), E.LookVector, if e < 0 then -1 else 1
    return {startTransform = E, direction = F * y, totalDistance = J, duration = t}
  end
  REGISTRY["parseTimedTransformArgs"] = parseTimedTransformArgs
end

        end
      else
        return
      end
      local u = t()
      if (u - F._lastCheckAt) < y then
        return
      end
      F._lastCheckAt = u
      if F._recoveryReason == nil then
        F:_onErrorMessageChanged(nil)
      end
      if F._teleporting then
        return
      elseif F._recoveryReason == nil then
        return
      elseif (u - F._lastRecoveryAttemptAt) < j then
        return
      end
      F._lastRecoveryAttemptAt = u
      F._recoveryAttempts = F._recoveryAttempts + 1
      local t, j = pcall(R.Teleport, R, O, e)
      if t then
        F._lastRecoveryError = nil
      else
        F._lastRecoveryError = tostring(j)
        if F.runtime then
          F.runtime:PushLog("warn", "session recovery teleport failed: " .. F._lastRecoveryError)
        end
      end
    end, Start = function(t)
      if not (t.runtime) then
        return
      end
      t:Stop()
      t._started = true
      t._lastCheckAt = -math.huge
      t._recoveryReason = nil
      t._recoverySince = nil
      t._lastRecoveryAttemptAt = -math.huge
      t._recoveryAttempts = 0
      t._lastRecoveryError = nil
      local F = E and E.ErrorMessageChanged
      if F then
        if type(F.Connect) == "function" then
          t.runtime:SetTask("sessionRecovery:errorMessage", F:Connect(function(E)
            t:_onErrorMessageChanged(E)
          end))
        end
      end
      if e then
        if e.OnTeleport then
          local E, j = t.runtime, function(O)
            t:_onTeleport(O)
          end
          E:SetTask("sessionRecovery:onTeleport", e.OnTeleport:Connect(j))
        end
      end
      t:_onErrorMessageChanged(nil)
      F = R and R.TeleportInitFailed
      if F then
        t.runtime:SetTask("sessionRecovery:teleportFailed", F:Connect(function(E, F, j)
          if t._started then
            if E == e then
              if F ~= Enum.TeleportResult.IsTeleporting then
                t._teleporting = false
              end
              t._lastRecoveryError = tostring(j)
            end
          end
        end))
      end
      t.runtime:StartInterval("sessionRecovery", y, function()
        t:_step()
      end)
    end, Stop = function(E)
      E._started = false
      E._teleporting = false
      if E.runtime then
        E.runtime:StopLoop("sessionRecovery")
        E.runtime:ClearTask("sessionRecovery:errorMessage")
        E.runtime:ClearTask("sessionRecovery:teleportFailed")
        E.runtime:ClearTask("sessionRecovery:onTeleport")
      end
    end, GetSnapshot = function(E)
      return {started = E._started, recoveryReason = E._recoveryReason, recoverySince = E._recoverySince, recoveryAttempts = E._recoveryAttempts, lastRecoveryError = E._lastRecoveryError, nativeTeleportActive = E._teleporting}
    end}
    return J
  end
  REGISTRY["initiateSessionRecovery"] = initiateSessionRecovery
end

        J._decisionSegmentChecker = j
      end
      return j
    end
    local function J(F, y)
      local j = RaycastParams.new()
      j.FilterType = F.FilterType
      j.FilterDescendantsInstances = F.FilterDescendantsInstances
      j.RespectCanCollide = true
      j.ExcludeInstances = y or b
      return j
    end
    B._physicalRaycastParams = function(F, y)
      local j = if y then not y else F:_inDecision()
      if j then
        if F._decisionPhysicalParams then
          return F._decisionPhysicalParams
        end
      end
      local z = J(if y then (F:_buildRaycastParams()) else (F:_raycastParams()), F._physicalClearanceIgnoredParts)
      if j then
        F._decisionPhysicalParams = z
      end
      return z
    end
    B.ResolveSupportedPosition = function(J, F)
      local y, j = J._root, J._humanoid
      if y then
        if not (j) then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
      local z, b, d, H, a, g = J:_physicalRaycastParams(), J:_usesTraversalGeometry(), J._traversalGeometry, J:MeasureCharacterFootprint(y) + t.Hazards.SafetyPadding, math.cos(math.rad(math.min(j.MaxSlopeAngle, 45))), ipairs
      local A, P = {Vector3.zero, Vector3.xAxis * H, -Vector3.xAxis * H, Vector3.zAxis * H, -Vector3.zAxis * H}
      for H, l in g(A) do
        H = J:_raycast((F + l) + (Vector3.yAxis * 3), -Vector3.yAxis * 27, z)
        if H then
          if H.Normal.Y < a then
            return nil
          elseif b then
            if type(d.isSupport) == "function" then
              if d.isSupport(H.Instance) ~= true then
                return nil
              end
            end
          end
        else
          return nil
        end
        if P then
          if math.abs(H.Position.Y - P) > 3 then
            return nil
          end
        end
        P = P or H.Position.Y
      end
      return Vector3.new(F.X, (P + j.HipHeight) + (y.Size.Y * 0.5), F.Z)
    end
    B.IsOnDestinationFloor = function(J, F)
      local y, j = J._root, J._humanoid
      if y then
        if j then
          if j.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
      else
        return false
      end
      j = J:ResolveSupportedPosition(y.Position)
      return ((j ~= nil) and (math.abs(j.Y - y.Position.Y) <= 3)) and (math.abs(j.Y - F.Y) <= 3)
    end
    local function J(F, y, j)
      local z, b, d = if y == "dodge" then (F:_raycastParams()) else (F:_physicalRaycastParams(j)), F._root, F._humanoid
      if if b then not d else not b then
        return function()
          return false
        end
      end
      local H = if y == "fullBody" then F:MeasureCharacterFootprint(b, j) + t.Hazards.SafetyPadding else if y == "localStep" then math.min(b.Size.X, b.Size.Z) * 0.5 else math.max(b.Size.X, b.Size.Z) * 0.5
      return e.Create({params = z, floorExclusions = if y == "fullBody" then F._physicalClearanceIgnoredParts else z.ExcludeInstances, radius = H, standingHeight = d.HipHeight + (b.Size.Y * 0.5), minimumNormal = math.cos(math.rad(math.min(d.MaxSlopeAngle, 45))), supportShoulders = y ~= "localStep", raycast = function(e, y, j)
        return F:_raycast(e, y, j)
      end})
    end
    B.CreateGroundedSegmentChecker = function(e, F)
      local y = if F then not F else e:_inDecision()
      if y then
        if e._decisionGroundedChecker then
          return e._decisionGroundedChecker
        end
      end
      local j = J(e, "fullBody", F)
      if y then
        e._decisionGroundedChecker = j
      end
      return j
    end
    B.DescribeDodgeObstacle = function(e, F, y)
      local j = y - F
      y = Vector3.new(j.X, 0, j.Z)
      if y.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
        return nil
      elseif not (e._root) then
        return nil
      end
      local z, b = e:_physicalRaycastParams(), e:MeasureCharacterFootprint(e._root) + t.Hazards.SafetyPadding
      local t, d = Vector3.new(-y.Z, 0, y.X).Unit * b, ipairs
      y = {Vector3.zero, t, -t}
      for H, a in d(y) do
        t = e:_raycast(F + a, j, z)
        if t then
          if t.Instance then
            if t.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
              H = t.Instance
              return {shape = "box", transform = H.CFrame, size = H.Size + Vector3.new(b * 2, 0, b * 2), source = H}
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    B.GetDodgeWaypoints = function(e)
      local t, F, y = {}, e._root, e._humanoid
      if F then
        if y then
          if e._waypoints then
            if not (e._waypointIndex) then
              return t
            end
          else
            return t
          end
        else
          return t
        end
      else
        return t
      end
      local j = y.HipHeight + (F.Size.Y * 0.5)
      for z = e._waypointIndex, math.min(#e._waypoints, e._waypointIndex + 5), 1 do
        y = e._waypoints[z]
        if y.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then
          break
        elseif math.abs((y.Position.Y + j) - F.Position.Y) > 3 then
          break
        end
        t[#t + 1] = Vector3.new(y.Position.X, F.Position.Y, y.Position.Z)
      end
      return t
    end
    B.CreateLocalSegmentChecker = function(e, t)
      local F = if t then not t else e:_inDecision()
      if F then
        if e._decisionLocalChecker then
          return e._decisionLocalChecker
        end
      end
      local y = J(e, "localStep", t)
      if F then
        e._decisionLocalChecker = y
      end
      return y
    end
    B.CreateDodgeSegmentChecker = function(e)
      local t = e:_inDecision()
      if t then
        if e._decisionDodgeChecker then
          return e._decisionDodgeChecker
        end
      end
      local F = J(e, "dodge", false)
      if t then
        e._decisionDodgeChecker = F
      end
      return F
    end
    B.CreateSpacePenalty = function(J, e)
      local t, F, y = J:_inDecision(), if type(e) == "table" then e else false, J._decisionSpacePenalties
      if t then
        if y then
          if y[F] then
            return y[F]
          end
        end
      end
      local j = if F ~= false then if J:_usesTraversalGeometry() then e else {} else {}
      e = u.CreatePenalty(J._root.Position, j, 48, J:CreateLocalSegmentChecker())
      if t then
        J._decisionSpacePenalties = y or {}
        J._decisionSpacePenalties[F] = e
      end
      return e
    end
    B._raycast = function(J, e, t, F)
      if J._decisionThread then
        J._decisionRaycastCount = (J._decisionRaycastCount or 0) + 1
      end
      return J._workspace:Raycast(e, t, F)
    end
    B.IsSegmentClear = function(J, e, t)
      local F = t - e
      if F.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
        return true
      end
      return J:_raycast(e, F, J:_raycastParams()) == nil
    end
    B.MeasureSegmentClearance = function(J, e, t, F)
      local y = math.max(tonumber(F) or 0, 0)
      if y <= 0.05 then
        return 0
      elseif typeof(t) ~= "Vector3" then
        return 0
      elseif t.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
        return 0
      end
      local j, u = t.Unit * y, J:_inDecision()
      F = (u and J._decisionClearanceParams) or nil
      if F then
      else
        F = J:_raycastParams()
        F = if J:_usesTraversalGeometry() then (J:_physicalRaycastParams()) else F
        if u then
          J._decisionClearanceParams = F
        end
      end
      u = J:_raycast(e, j, F)
      if not u then
        return y
      end
      return (u.Position - e).Magnitude
    end
    B._usesTraversalGeometry = function(J)
      local e = J:_inDecision()
      if e then
        if J._decisionTraversalGeometry ~= nil then
          return J._decisionTraversalGeometry
        end
      end
      local t = J._traversalGeometry
      local F = ((t ~= nil) and (type(t.isActive) == "function")) and (t.isActive(J._workspace) == true)
      if e then
        J._decisionTraversalGeometry = F
      end
      return F
    end
    B.IsDirectRouteClear = function(J, e)
      local t = J._root
      if not (t) then
        return false
      end
      if math.abs(e.Y - t.Position.Y) > E then
        return false
      end
      if J:_usesTraversalGeometry() then
        return J:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker()(t.Position, e)
      end
      return J:IsSegmentClear(t.Position, e)
    end
    B.MoveToDirect = function(J, e, t, F, y, j)
      local u, z = J._root, J._humanoid
      if u then
        if z then
          if z.Health <= 0 then
            J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto_rejected"
            return false
          elseif typeof(e) ~= "Vector3" then
            J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto_rejected"
            return false
          end
        else
          J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto_rejected"
          return false
        end
      else
        J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto_rejected"
        return false
      end
      j = ((type(j) == "table") and j) or {}
      if J:_usesTraversalGeometry() then
        if j.allowUngroundedTransition ~= true then
          if j.geometryValidated ~= true then
            if not (J:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker(true)(u.Position, e)) then
              J:Cancel()
              J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto_geometry_blocked"
              return false
            end
          end
        end
      end
      if not (F) then
        if J._path then
          J:_invalidatePath("direct_moveto")
        elseif J._computingPath then
          J:_invalidatePath("direct_moveto")
        elseif J._mode == "path" then
          J:_invalidatePath("direct_moveto")
        end
        J._destination = e
        J._mode = "direct"
      end
      J._contextKey = t
      J._localDestination = e
      J:_faceTarget()
      u = J:_moveTo(e, y)
      if u then
        J._lastRouteDecision = "direct_moveto"
      end
      return u
    end
    B.SetRoomBoundaries = function(J, e)
      J._roomBoundaries = {}
      for t, t in ipairs(e) do
        if t.kind == "room_boundary" then
          table.insert(J._roomBoundaries, t)
        end
      end
      if J._root then
        if J._lastCommandPosition then
          if O.MovementBarrier(J._root.Position, J._lastCommandPosition, J._roomBoundaries) then
            J:Cancel()
          end
        end
      end
    end
    B._moveTo = function(J, e, t)
      if J._root then
        if O.MovementBarrier(J._root.Position, e, J._roomBoundaries or {}) then
          J:Cancel()
          J._lastRouteDecision = "room_boundary"
          return false
        end
      end
      J._speedPaused = false
      local F = J._humanoid
      if F then
        if F.Health <= 0 then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      if t then
        F.Jump = true
        J._pendingPathJump = false
      end
      F:MoveTo(e)
      if J._nativeDirection then
        J._directionTarget = e
        J._directionPrevious = nil
      end
      J._lastCommandPosition = e
      J._lastCommandOrigin = (J._root and J._root.Position) or nil
      J._lastCommandAt = J._clock()
      J._moveCommandCount = J._moveCommandCount + 1
      J:_observeProgress(e)
      return true
    end
    B._resetProgress = function(J)
      J._progressPosition = nil
      J._progressAt = nil
      J._progressCommandAt = nil
      J._progressStalled = false
    end
    B._observeProgress = function(J, e)
      if J._traversalGeometry then
        if not (J._traversalGeometry.recoverStalls) then
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local t, F = J._clock(), J._root.Position
      if Vector3.new(e.X - F.X, 0, e.Z - F.Z).Magnitude <= _ then
        if Q(J._root, J._humanoid, e, nil, Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk) then
          J:_resetProgress()
          return
        end
      end
      if J._progressPosition then
        if J._progressCommandAt then
          if (t - J._progressCommandAt) > r then
            J._progressPosition = F
            J._progressAt = t
            J._progressStalled = false
          elseif (F - J._progressPosition).Magnitude >= _ then
            J._progressPosition = F
            J._progressAt = t
            J._progressStalled = false
          elseif (t - J._progressAt) >= c then
            J._progressStalled = true
          end
        else
          J._progressPosition = F
          J._progressAt = t
          J._progressStalled = false
        end
      else
        J._progressPosition = F
        J._progressAt = t
        J._progressStalled = false
      end
      J._progressCommandAt = t
    end
    B._driveNative = function(J, e)
      local t, F, y = J._root, J._humanoid, J._directionTarget
      if t then
        if F then
          if F.Health <= 0 then
            return
          elseif y then
          else
            return
          end
        else
          return
        end
      else
        return
      end
      local j = Vector3.new(y.X - t.Position.X, 0, y.Z - t.Position.Z)
      t = J._directionPrevious and (j:Dot(J._directionPrevious) <= 0)
      if (j.Magnitude <= 0.04) or t then
        J._directionTarget = nil
        J._directionPrevious = nil
        F:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        return
      end
      y = math.min(j.Magnitude / math.max(F.WalkSpeed * e, 0.001), 1)
      F:Move(j.Unit * y, false)
      J._directionPrevious = j
    end
    B._computePath = function(J, e)
      local t = J._root
      if not t then
        J._lastPathFailureReason = "missing_root"
        return false
      end
      if J._computingPath then
        J._lastPathFailureReason = "already_computing"
        return false
      end
      local F = J._clock()
      if J._traversalGeometry then
        if J._traversalGeometry.recoverStalls then
          if J._pathComputeAttempts > 0 then
            if (F - J._lastComputeAt) < L then
              return false
            end
          end
        end
      end
      J._lastComputeAt = F
      J._pathComputeAttempts = J._pathComputeAttempts + 1
      J._pathComputeSerial = J._pathComputeSerial + 1
      local F = J._pathComputeSerial
      local y = J._generation
      local j = t.Position
      J._computeOrigin = j
      local u = J._pathfindingService:CreatePath({AgentRadius = (J._traversalGeometry and J._traversalGeometry.agentRadius) or 3, AgentHeight = 5, AgentCanJump = true, Costs = J._traversalGeometry and J._traversalGeometry.pathCosts})
      J._activePathComputeSerial = F
      J._computingPath = true
      J._computeDestination = e
      task.spawn(function()
        local z = pcall(function()
          u:ComputeAsync(j, e)
        end)
        if J._activePathComputeSerial ~= F then
          return
        end
        J._activePathComputeSerial = nil
        J._computingPath = false
        J._computeDestination = nil
        local F = J._queuedPathDestination
        J._queuedPathDestination = nil
        if ((y ~= J._generation) or (t ~= J._root)) or not t.Parent then
          J._pathDiscardCount = J._pathDiscardCount + 1
          J._lastPathFailureReason = "stale_result"
          return
        end
        if F then
          J._pathDiscardCount = J._pathDiscardCount + 1
          J._lastPathFailureReason = "retargeted"
          J:_computePath(F)
          return
        end
        if if z then u.Status ~= Enum.PathStatus.Success else not z then
          J._pathComputeFailures = J._pathComputeFailures + 1
          J._lastPathFailureReason = if z then "status:" .. tostring(u.Status) else "compute_error"
          J:_invalidatePath("path_failed")
          J._lastRouteDecision = "path_failed"
          return
        end
        F = u:GetWaypoints()
        if #F == 0 then
          J._pathComputeFailures = J._pathComputeFailures + 1
          J._lastPathFailureReason = "empty_waypoints"
          J:_invalidatePath("path_failed")
          J._lastRouteDecision = "path_failed"
          return
        end
        local t = J:_invalidatePath("replace_with_computed_path")
        J._path = u
        J._waypoints = F
        J._pathDestination = e
        J._lastPathAt = J._clock()
        J._lastPathOrigin = j
        J._waypointIndex = if #F > 1 then 2 else 1
        J._mode = "path"
        J._lastPathFailureReason = nil
        J._lastRouteDecision = "path_computed"
        J._blockedConnection = u.Blocked:Connect(function(e)
          if t ~= J._generation then
            return
          end
          J:_faceTarget()
          if J._waypointIndex then
            if e >= J._waypointIndex then
              local e = J._destination
              J._lastRouteDecision = "path_blocked"
              if typeof(e) == "Vector3" then
                J:_computePath(e)
              end
            end
          end
        end)
      end)
      return true
    end
    B._nextWaypoint = function(J)
      local e = J._root
      local t, F = J._waypoints, J._waypointIndex
      if not e or not t then
        return false
      elseif F then
      else
        return false
      end
      local function y(j, u)
        if Q(e, J._humanoid, j.Position, (u and u.Position) or nil, j.Action) then
          return true
        end
        if J._traversalGeometry then
          if J._traversalGeometry.recoverStalls then
            if j.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then
              return false
            elseif u then
              if u.Action ~= Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk then
                return false
              elseif j.Position.Y <= (e.Position.Y + E) then
                return false
              elseif Vector3.new(j.Position.X - e.Position.X, 0, j.Position.Z - e.Position.Z).Magnitude > E then
                return false
              end
            else
              return false
            end
          else
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
        local z = J:ResolveSupportedPosition(j.Position)
        if z then
          if (z - e.Position).Magnitude > E then
            return false
          end
        else
          return false
        end
        z = J:ResolveSupportedPosition(u.Position)
        return (z ~= nil) and J:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker()(e.Position, z)
      end
      local E = t[F]
      local j = false
      while E and y(E, t[F + 1]) do
        if E.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
          J._pendingPathJump = true
        end
        F += 1
        E, j = t[F], true
      end
      J._waypointIndex = F
      if not (E) then
        if j then
          J:_faceTarget()
        end
        J:_disconnectPath()
        if J._pendingPathJump then
          return e.Position, true
        end
        return false
      end
      return E.Position, J._pendingPathJump or (E.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump)
    end
    local function J(E, e)
      local t = E._traversalGeometry and E._traversalGeometry.walkingStep
      if t then
        if t <= 0 then
          return nil
        elseif E._pendingPathJump then
          return nil
        end
      else
        return nil
      end
      local F = E._root.Position
      local y = Vector3.new(e.X - F.X, 0, e.Z - F.Z)
      if y.Magnitude <= 0.05 then
        return nil
      end
      e = math.min(t, y.Magnitude)
      for j = 1, 3, 1 do
        t = E:ResolveSupportedPosition(F + (y.Unit * e))
        if t then
          if E:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker()(F, t) then
            return t
          end
        end
        e *= 0.5
      end
      return nil
    end
    local function E(e, t)
      local F = e._root.Position
      local y = Vector3.new(t.X - F.X, 0, t.Z - F.Z)
      if y.Magnitude <= _ then
        return nil
      end
      t = y.Unit
      y = Vector3.new(-t.Z, 0, t.X)
      y = if (e._stallRecoveries % 2) == 0 then -y else y
      local j, u, z = e:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker(true), ipairs, {y, -y, (y - t).Unit, (-y - t).Unit, -t}
      for t, t in u(z) do
        y = e:ResolveSupportedPosition(F + (t * 4))
        if y then
          if math.abs(y.Y - F.Y) <= 3 then
            if j(F, y) then
              if not (O.MovementBarrier(F, y, e._roomBoundaries or {})) then
                return y
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
    B.ResolveDestination = function(e, t, F)
      local y, j = e._root, e._humanoid
      if y then
        if j then
          if j.Health <= 0 then
            e._lastRouteDecision = "invalid_character"
            return nil
          elseif typeof(t) ~= "Vector3" then
            e._lastRouteDecision = "invalid_character"
            return nil
          end
        else
          e._lastRouteDecision = "invalid_character"
          return nil
        end
      else
        e._lastRouteDecision = "invalid_character"
        return nil
      end
      if e._routeContextKey ~= F then
        e:_invalidatePath("goal_changed")
        e:_resetProgress()
        e._forcePathOrigin = nil
        e._recoveryStep = nil
        e._routeContextKey = F
      end
      e._contextKey = F
      e._destination = t
      F = e._clock()
      if e._progressStalled then
        if not (e._computingPath) then
          local u, z = e._waypoints and e._waypoints[e._waypointIndex], e._pendingPathJump
          j = if z then not z else if u then u.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk else not u
          e:_invalidatePath("movement_stalled")
          e:_resetProgress()
          e._stallRecoveries = e._stallRecoveries + 1
          e._forcePathOrigin = y.Position
          e._recoveryStep = if j then (E(e, t)) else nil
          e._recoveryStartedAt = F
        end
      end
      if e._recoveryStep then
        j = e._recoveryStep
        if (j - y.Position).Magnitude > _ then
          if (F - e._recoveryStartedAt) < c then
            if e:CreateGroundedSegmentChecker()(y.Position, j) then
              if not (O.MovementBarrier(y.Position, j, e._roomBoundaries or {})) then
                e._lastRouteDecision = "stalled_route_sidestep"
                return j, false
              end
            end
          end
        end
        e._recoveryStep = nil
        e:_resetProgress()
      end
      if e._forcePathOrigin then
        if (y.Position - e._forcePathOrigin).Magnitude >= 4 then
          e._forcePathOrigin = nil
        end
      end
      j = e._computeDestination
      if j then
        if (j - t).Magnitude > 12 then
          if (F - e._lastComputeAt) >= C then
            e:_invalidatePath("goal_moved_timeout")
          else
            e._queuedPathDestination = t
            e:_disconnectPath()
            e._pendingPathJump = false
          end
        else
          e._queuedPathDestination = nil
        end
      elseif e._pathDestination then
        if (e._pathDestination - t).Magnitude > 12 then
          e:_invalidatePath("goal_moved")
        end
      end
      if not (e._forcePathOrigin) then
        if e:IsDirectRouteClear(t) then
          j = e._pendingPathJump
          if e._path then
            e:_invalidatePath("switch_to_direct")
          elseif e._computingPath then
            e:_invalidatePath("switch_to_direct")
          end
          e._mode = "direct"
          y = if j then not j else J(e, t)
          if y then
            return y, false
          end
          return t, j
        end
      end
      F, y = e:_nextWaypoint()
      if F then
        return (if y then not y else J(e, F)) or F, y
      end
      if not (e._computingPath) then
        e:_computePath(t)
      end
      if e._computingPath then
        F = J(e, t)
        if F then
          e._lastRouteDecision = "path_compute_advance"
          return F, false
        end
      end
      e._lastRouteDecision = "path_computing"
      return nil
    end
    B.Step = function(J, E, e)
      local t, F = J:ResolveDestination(E, e)
      if not (t) then
        return false
      end
      J._localDestination = nil
      J:_faceTarget()
      return J:_moveTo(t, F)
    end
    B.Pause = function(J)
      J._speedPaused = true
